2	-- Migration: payments_l2_nec_1099_aggregate
3	-- File:      20260512100000_payments_l2_nec_1099_aggregate.sql
4	-- Created:   2026-05-12
5	-- Sprint:    S20 Track B — Stripe Connect Marketplace Foundation
6	-- =============================================================================
7	-- Description:
8	--   Adds a read-only RPC nec_1099_aggregate(p_studio_id, p_year) that
9	--   aggregates per-artist earnings from commission_splits for a given tax
10	--   year and returns a JSONB payload matching Nec1099AggregateResult in
11	--   lib/payments/contracts.ts (CC48 rule — key names must match exactly).
12	--
13	-- Tables read (no DDL changes):
14	--   - commission_splits        (from 20260505100000_payments_l2_stripe_connect_schema.sql)
15	--   - artists                  (pre-existing)
16	--   - profiles                 (pre-existing)
17	--   - stripe_connected_accounts (from 20260505100000_payments_l2_stripe_connect_schema.sql)
18	--
19	-- RPCs added:
20	--   - nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) RETURNS jsonb
21	--
22	-- Security:
23	--   - SECURITY DEFINER + SET search_path = public
24	--   - REVOKE from PUBLIC and authenticated
25	--   - GRANT EXECUTE to service_role only
26	--   - No RLS required — read-only, service_role caller enforces access control
27	--
28	-- Rollback (DOWN):
29	--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) CASCADE;
30	-- =============================================================================
31	
32	-- =============================================================================
33	-- DOWN (rollback — run manually to undo)
34	-- DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) CASCADE;
35	-- =============================================================================
36	
37	-- =============================================================================
38	-- UP
39	-- =============================================================================

41	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nec_1099_aggregate(
42	  p_studio_id uuid,
43	  p_year      int
44	) RETURNS jsonb
45	LANGUAGE plpgsql
46	SECURITY DEFINER
47	SET search_path = public
48	AS $$
49	DECLARE
50	  v_result jsonb;
51	BEGIN
52	  WITH artist_agg AS (
53	    SELECT
54	      cs.artist_id,
55	      COALESCE(p.full_name, a.display_name, 'Unknown Artist') AS artist_name,
56	      SUM(cs.base_amount_cents)::bigint                        AS total_paid_cents,
57	      -- H10 fix: scalar subquery instead of LEFT JOIN to avoid duplicate rows when
58	      -- an artist has multiple stripe_connected_accounts rows (e.g. one expired + one current).
59	      COALESCE(
60	        (SELECT (capabilities->>'tax_reporting_us_1099_nec')::boolean
61	         FROM stripe_connected_accounts
62	         WHERE artist_id = cs.artist_id
63	           AND type      = 'artist'
64	           AND studio_id = p_studio_id
65	         ORDER BY created_at DESC
66	         LIMIT 1),
67	        false
68	      )                                                        AS stripe_1099_capable
69	    FROM commission_splits cs
70	    JOIN artists a
71	      ON a.id = cs.artist_id
72	    LEFT JOIN profiles p
73	      ON p.id = a.profile_id
74	    WHERE cs.studio_id = p_studio_id
75	      AND cs.kind      = 'split'
76	      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cs.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = p_year
77	    GROUP BY
78	      cs.artist_id,
79	      p.full_name,
80	      a.display_name
81	    ORDER BY total_paid_cents DESC
82	  ),
83	  artist_rows AS (
84	    SELECT
85	      jsonb_build_object(
86	        'artist_id',           artist_id::text,
87	        'artist_name',         artist_name,
88	        'total_paid_cents',    total_paid_cents,
89	        'nec_threshold_met',   total_paid_cents >= 60000,
90	        'stripe_1099_capable', stripe_1099_capable
91	      ) AS row_obj,
92	      CASE WHEN total_paid_cents >= 60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS threshold_flag
93	    FROM artist_agg
94	  )
95	  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
96	    'year',                p_year,
97	    'studio_id',           p_studio_id::text,
98	    'artists',             COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_obj ORDER BY (row_obj->>'total_paid_cents')::bigint DESC), '[]'::jsonb),
99	    'total_artists',       COUNT(*)::int,
100	    'threshold_met_count', COALESCE(SUM(threshold_flag), 0)::int
101	  )
102	  INTO v_result
103	  FROM artist_rows;
104	
105	  RETURN v_result;
106	END;
107	$$;
108	
109	COMMENT ON FUNCTION nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) IS
110	  'S20 — Returns 1099-NEC aggregation for a studio + tax year. '
111	  'Sums commission_splits.base_amount_cents where kind = ''split''. '
112	  'nec_threshold_met = total_paid_cents >= 60000 (IRS $600 threshold). '
113	  'Caller must be service_role; PUBLIC and authenticated are revoked. '
114	  'Return shape: Nec1099AggregateResult (lib/payments/contracts.ts, CC48).';
115	
116	-- =============================================================================
117	-- Permission hardening
118	-- =============================================================================
119	
120	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) FROM PUBLIC;
121	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) FROM authenticated;
122	GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nec_1099_aggregate(uuid, int) TO service_role;
123

1	import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
2	import { z } from 'zod'
3	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
4	import { logAuditAction } from '@/lib/audit'
5	import { createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
6	import { RPC, type Nec1099AggregateResult, type Nec1099ExportRecordArgs } from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
7	import { adminExportRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
8	import { requirePlatformAdmin } from '@/lib/admin/require-platform-admin'
9	
10	const BodySchema = z.object({
11	  studioId: z.string().uuid(),
12	  year: z.number().int().min(2024).max(2099),
13	})
14	
15	export async function POST(req: NextRequest): Promise<Response> {
16	  const auth = await requirePlatformAdmin(req)
17	  if (auth instanceof NextResponse) return auth
18	
19	  const rl = await adminExportRatelimit.limit(auth.userId)
20	  if (!rl.success) {
21	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'rate_limited' }, { status: 429 })
22	  }
23	
24	  let body: unknown
25	  try {
26	    body = await req.json()
27	  } catch {
28	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'invalid_json' }, { status: 400 })
29	  }
30	
31	  const parsed = BodySchema.safeParse(body)
32	  if (!parsed.success) {
33	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'validation', issues: parsed.error.issues }, { status: 400 })
34	  }
35	
36	  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
37	
38	  // §S13.3 — nec_1099_aggregate not yet in generated types.ts; cast to untyped rpc.
39	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as (
40	    fn: string,
41	    args: Record<string, unknown>,
42	  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>
43	
44	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.NEC_1099_AGGREGATE, {
45	    p_studio_id: parsed.data.studioId,
46	    p_year: parsed.data.year,
47	  })
48	
49	  if (error) {
50	    logger.error(
51	      { studio_id: parsed.data.studioId, year: parsed.data.year, err: error },
52	      'nec_1099_aggregate RPC failed',
53	    )
54	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'export_failed' }, { status: 500 })
55	  }
56	
57	  const result = data as Nec1099AggregateResult
58	
59	  // §S13.3 — nec_1099_exports not yet in generated types.ts; cast to untyped rpc.
60	  const rpcUpsert = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as (
61	    fn: string,
62	    args: Record<string, unknown>,
63	  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>
64	
65	  const thresholdMet = result.artists.filter((a) => a.nec_threshold_met)
66	
67	  let failedCount = 0
68	  for (const artist of thresholdMet) {
69	    const exportArgs: Nec1099ExportRecordArgs = {
70	      studioId: parsed.data.studioId,
71	      year: result.year,
72	      artistId: artist.artist_id,
73	      totalPaidCents: artist.total_paid_cents,
74	      federalIdLast4: null,
75	      stateIdLast4: null,
76	      csvUrl: null,
77	      pdfUrl: null,
78	      source: 'stripe',
79	    }
80	
81	    const { error: recErr } = await rpcUpsert(RPC.NEC_1099_EXPORT_RECORD, {
82	      p_studio_id: exportArgs.studioId,
83	      p_year: exportArgs.year,
84	      p_artist_id: exportArgs.artistId,
85	      p_total_paid_cents: exportArgs.totalPaidCents,
86	      p_federal_id_last4: exportArgs.federalIdLast4,
87	      p_state_id_last4: exportArgs.stateIdLast4,
88	      p_csv_url: exportArgs.csvUrl,
89	      p_pdf_url: exportArgs.pdfUrl,
90	      p_source: exportArgs.source,
91	    })
92	
93	    if (recErr) {
94	      logger.error(
95	        { artist_id: artist.artist_id, year: parsed.data.year, err: recErr },
96	        'nec_1099_export_record upsert failed',
97	      )
98	      failedCount++
99	    }
100	  }
101	
102	  // All upserts failed — nothing persisted, return 500
103	  if (failedCount > 0 && failedCount === thresholdMet.length) {
104	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'export_record_failed' }, { status: 500 })
105	  }
106	
107	  // Build CSV — all artists (not just threshold met) for full picture
108	  const lines: string[] = []
109	  lines.push('artist_id,artist_name,total_paid_cents,nec_threshold_met,stripe_1099_capable')
110	  for (const artist of result.artists) {
111	    lines.push(
112	      [
113	        artist.artist_id,
114	        `"${artist.artist_name.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
115	        artist.total_paid_cents,
116	        artist.nec_threshold_met ? 'true' : 'false',
117	        artist.stripe_1099_capable ? 'true' : 'false',
118	      ].join(','),
119	    )
120	  }
121	  lines.push(`IRS_THRESHOLD_CENTS,60000,,,`)
122	  lines.push(`TOTAL_THRESHOLD_MET,${result.threshold_met_count},,,`)
123	  if (failedCount > 0) {
124	    lines.push(`# WARN: ${failedCount} of ${result.threshold_met_count} export records failed to persist`)
125	  }
126	  const csv = lines.join('\n') + '\n'
127	
128	  await logAuditAction(
129	    auth.userId,
130	    'admin_nec_1099_export',
131	    { type: 'studio', id: parsed.data.studioId },
132	    {
133	      year: parsed.data.year,
134	      studio_id: parsed.data.studioId,
135	      total_artists: result.total_artists,
136	      threshold_met_count: result.threshold_met_count,
137	      failed_upsert_count: failedCount,
138	    },
139	    parsed.data.studioId,
140	  )
141	
142	  return new Response(csv, {
143	    status: 200,
144	    headers: {
145	      'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8',
146	      'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="nec1099-${parsed.data.studioId}-${parsed.data.year}.csv"`,
147	    },
148	  })
149	}
